internal_policy: Names that are not re-exported through ncmemsim.transport.__all__, including underscore-prefixed implementation helpers, remain internal unless they are already protected by the frozen v1.0 contract.
selection_rationale: The 44 explicit Phase J ncmemsim.transport package exports remain public. Thirty-four configuration, aggregate evaluator/result, integration, sensitivity and reporting paths are proposed for v1.1 stabilization because they form the documented construction and interpretation surface. Ten lower-level barrier, single-species and numerical helper paths remain public provisional so later minor releases may refine their detailed diagnostic/numerical contracts without expanding the stable compatibility promise.

result_semantics_review.configuration_and_provenance: TrapSpecies, TrapAssistedTransportSpec, ImageForceBarrierSpec and AdvancedTransportSpec retain explicit SI units, provenance/status fields and deterministic configuration/evidence hashes; hashes prove internal consistency, not source authenticity or calibration.
result_semantics_review.conditional_rate_results: TAT result objects report conditional pathway frequencies in Hz with explicit component/status diagnostics. They are not device leakage current density and do not establish a calibrated defect population.
result_semantics_review.integrated_transport_results: Integrated results retain the direct baseline plus ordered mechanism contributions. `DISABLED`/`NOT_ATTACHED` zero contribution is distinct from `FAILED`; optional failures are link-local and preserve finite direct/net state accounting.
result_semantics_review.sensitivity_results: Transport sensitivity is local one-at-a-time compact-model evidence. Density and capture cross section remain structurally confounded in the active-path factor; the result is not probabilistic global sensitivity or manufacturing variation evidence.
result_semantics_review.report_results: AdvancedTransportReport is a portable integrity-checked snapshot with mechanism and parameter provenance exports. Report hashes establish consistency, not experimental calibration, fabricated-device prediction or manufacturing yield.

public_provisional_rationale: Public provisional paths are intentionally importable and tested, but are not part of the proposed stable v1.1 compatibility set. They are low-level numerical or diagnostic primitives: raw barrier-profile construction, single-species evaluation, direct image-force/barrier manipulation and the scalar WKB helper. High-level stable candidates may return diagnostics derived from them, but their direct import paths and callable signatures are not separately frozen by J7a.
